name: the plan kept current: correcting, updating and re-circulating the template
what_it_changes: P04 says members circulate a template or coordinates and ask strays to keep to them. In these rooms the template needs upkeep of its own: members correct the reference against the canvas, replace stale plans, make updates noticeable, route helpers to the current version and message friendly placers who still follow a superseded one.
why: Cut rules R1 and R2 (tree-D4.md), with R1a (the level): the key's lines, read whole in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-step_P04_T4-008.txt, state one shared change to P04. R1a: T3-070 (sharing coordinates, templates and how-to) holds 33 of the 42 rooms, just under 80 per cent, so the branch is declared at the fourth order. 'Members correct references against current placements and replace stale plans' (FloydVsVoid); 'Helpers request warnings on obsolete templates and links to current designs so intended repair does not undo the plan' (monalisaclan); 'Revised targets need repeated visibility work among keepers who otherwise restore the old form' (linux). These are the labelers' how sentences.
